validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="count" expr="0"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <onentry>
      <assign location="count + 1" expr="2"/>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `location` is not an assignable ecmascript location: expected a variable name or property access
notes: a location expression must name a place in the data model that can be assigned, such as a variable name or a property access like `a.b` or `a[0]`
diagnostics.help: use a declared variable name or a member expression
